description: This file defines the FactorAuthFactory class responsible for managing and providing instances of factor authentication classes within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving factor authentication objects based on user data, with error handling for missing user information.

classes.name: FactorAuthFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing factor authentication instances based on user data.

methods.name: getFactorAuth
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of a factor authentication class for a given user, creating it if necessary.
